verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party accounting-software integration or automatic transaction/expense sync for Wise Business. What it does document is adjacent: balance statements exportable in accounting-friendly formats (CAMT.053, MT940, QIF, CSV), plus webhook and API primitives a developer could use to build a sync. These are manual exports and building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can sync transactions and expenses automatically with my accounting software
